resources.string: Reminder: is the charger unplugged? (the phone is away from the battery)
%1$d notifications will be deleted from this history. Reports are not affected.
Recovery %1$.1f %% this time, well above your usual %2$.1f %%: more descents or gentler braking.
Recovery %1$.1f %% this time, below your usual %2$.1f %%: flatter route or harder braking with the mechanical brakes.
Over %1$.0f km your vehicle recovered only %2$.1f %% of its energy: its controller recovers little or not at all. Nothing wrong with the battery.
Free descent: %1$.2f km gained speed without drawing from the battery.
